```sql
SELECT issuing_country, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM main.payments
GROUP BY issuing_country
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT ip_country
FROM main.payments
WHERE has_fraudulent_dispute = TRUE
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
```

```sql
SELECT 
  AVG(p.has_fraudulent_dispute) AS fraud_rate
FROM 
  main.payments p
WHERE 
  p.merchant = 'Martinis_Fine_Steakhouse'
  AND p.has_fraudulent_dispute = TRUE;
```

```sql
SELECT 
  AVG(CAST(p.has_fraudulent_dispute AS DOUBLE)) AS fraud_rate
FROM 
  main.payments p
WHERE 
  p.merchant = 'Martinis_Fine_Steakhouse'
  AND p.has_fraudulent_dispute = TRUE;
```
